column1: # Archipelago log-line contract shared by the AutoHotkey, PowerShell/WPF and Vulkan runtimes.
# Format: <input line><TAB><expected overlay text>, split on the LAST tab. <none> = not shown.
# Contract:
#   1. Prefix ^\[(FileLog|Client) at [^\]]+\]:\s*(.*) is case-sensitive.
#   2. The message is shown only if it contains one of these keywords, compared
#      case-insensitively: test, found their, completed their goal, Congratulations,
#      released all remaining. The keyword check runs before step 3.
#   3. A trailing location is removed with \s*\(.*\)\s*$ (from the FIRST '(' when the
#      message ends in ')'), then spaces and tabs are trimmed from both ends.
#   4. An empty result is not shown.
# Inputs never contain tabs. Some inputs end in spaces on purpose; keep them.
# Each keyword, one trailing location
